cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Started the Spiral
cards.instruction: Hide how much your own fear or resentment created the emotional crisis while helping everyone calm it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The club money's in the other envelope. Let's tell everyone they can stop worrying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You phoned me crying that the treasurer had stolen it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And you're the first person I'm reassuring. Could you pass on that it's all accounted for?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I told the whole committee what you said.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll ring them together. Could you introduce it as a routine balance update? No need to replay the tears.

mechanism: A appoints B as messenger of calm and scripts a routine update to hide the crying accusation A used to start the alarm.
confusable: D85 concerns relationship distance; D109 concerns emotional crisis amplified by A own fear or resentment.
comparison: A club-money accusation differs from forecast-driven transport cancellation.
seedUse: Use D109-b found envelope and B committee-wide spread to cause A broader corrective call with controlled framing.
